gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold states the headache had a gradual onset a few hours ago. Generated HPI-001 describes a sudden onset a few hours prior, which directly contradicts the onset description. Location and timing are otherwise represented in CC-001/HPI-002 but the onset character is reversed.

Gold: throbbing, non‑radiating headache. Generated HPI-002 states the headache is throbbing and left-sided; it does not mention radiation but does not contradict ‘nil radiating’. The key attribute ‘throbbing’ is explicitly captured, and there is no conflicting statement about radiation.

Gold: visual aura with zigzag lines before onset of headache. Generated HPI-003: transient zigzag visual lines minutes before onset consistent with aura. This fully captures the gold fact with added timing detail.

Gold: associated photophobia and blurred vision. Generated HPI-004 (blurred vision in both eyes) and HPI-005 (photophobia, wearing sunglasses) together cover both symptoms; laterality of blurred vision is an added detail but consistent.
Gold: feels nauseous and vomited twice today. Generated CC-001 and HPI-006 both note nausea and two episodes of vomiting. This matches fully.
Gold: worsening of pain with movement (neck). Generated HPI-002: headache worse with movement including leaning/neck movement. This directly captures and slightly expands on the aggravating factor.

Gold: denies speech disturbances, limb weakness or numbness, and coordination/balance issues. Generated HPI-010 and ROS-001 repeat denial of speech disturbance, limb numbness/weakness, and balance/coordination problems, matching the gold fact.
Gold: denies recent head injury, fever, or rashes. Generated HPI-011 (no recent head injury), HPI-007/ROS-002 (no fever), and HPI-008/ROS-003 (no rash) together fully cover this.

Gold: patient is worried about possibility of brain cancer. None of the generated facts explicitly state that the patient is worried about brain cancer or any malignancy; ASM-002 mentions reassurance about low likelihood of brain tumor but not that this was a specific patient concern.
Gold: no significant past medical history. Generated PMH-001: no past medical history reported. These are equivalent in clinical meaning.
Gold: patient takes Microgynon. Generated MED-001: taking Microgynon for contraception, started three months ago. This includes the gold fact plus extra details.
Gold: no known drug allergies. There is no generated fact about allergies or adverse drug reactions.
Gold: mother has migraines. Generated FH-001: mother with migraines. Fully matches.
Gold: mother has an underactive thyroid. Generated FH-002: mother with underactive thyroid. Fully matches.
Gold: lives alone and works in fashion industry. Generated SH-001: lives alone; SH-002: works in fashion industry. Together they cover the full gold fact.

Gold: feeling very stressed but denies mood symptoms. Generated SH-002: works in fashion industry and reports high stress (covers stress) but there is no mention of denial of mood symptoms. Thus only the stress component is captured.

Gold: no history of smoking or alcohol use. Generated SH-003: does not smoke, and SH-004: minimal or no alcohol use. This effectively covers the gold (allowing for ‘minimal’ vs ‘nil’ alcohol as a slight softening but not a contradiction).
Gold: impression is migraine. Generated ASM-001: probable migraine headache with visual aura. This contains and elaborates the diagnosis; no conflict.
Gold: advised to keep a headache diary. Generated PLAN-003: advised to keep a headache diary to identify triggers. Fully consistent, with added purpose.

Gold: recommended regular paracetamol and/or NSAIDs. Generated PLAN-001 and PLAN-002 recommend paracetamol/co-codamol and NSAIDs (ibuprofen/naproxen) as acute treatment but do not specify ‘regular’ dosing. Thus the medication types are covered, but the ‘regular’ regimen detail is omitted.

Gold: review in one week to discuss prophylactic treatment. Generated PLAN-006 and FU-001: review next week with offer to discuss prophylaxis (migraine prophylaxis) and OCP implications. The follow-up timing and prophylaxis discussion are clearly captured.

Gold: seek review earlier if worsening symptoms or any concerns (explicitly headaches, vomiting, vision symptoms). Generated PLAN-005: safety-netting to return urgently if worsening headache, progressive neck pain, new focal deficits, worsening vision, or no improvement in 2–3 days. Worsening headache and vision worsening are covered, but vomiting and the general ‘any concerns’ instruction are not explicitly mentioned; additional criteria (neck pain, focal deficits, 2–3 days) are added.

Generated: headache began suddenly a few hours prior. Gold HPI-001: gradual onset a few hours ago. Onset character is directly opposite.

Gold assessment: migraine. Generated: probable migraine with visual aura, citing unilateral throbbing, photophobia, N/V, prior similar episode. Diagnosis is supported; prior similar episode is an added element, and ‘probable’ vs firm impression is a mild qualification, not a contradiction.

The risk assessment and reassurance are reasonable inferences but not directly documented in gold, so this is an addition built on gold-supported negatives.
